identity.mission: Create a restaurant SaaS that feels like a Michelin-star kitchen: precise, clean, and emotionally resonant. Avoid generic 'admin panel' vibes.
principles: Fusion: Culinary Art x Digital Precision
Content: Food is the hero, UI is the plate
Zoom: Macro details for food, micro details for data
Negative Space: Breathing room for digestion (visual and informational)

headings.usage: Public Menu Headings, Featured Items, Brand Moments

body.usage: Admin Interface, Public Menu Descriptions, Prices, UI Elements

mono.usage: Order IDs, SKU codes, API keys, Financial Data

primary.name: Sage & Earth
primary.description: Organic, fresh, trustworthy. Used for primary actions and brand identity.

secondary.name: Terracotta
secondary.description: Warmth, appetite, alerts. Used for accents and 'hot' items.

admin_dashboard.rules: Dense data, high scanability. Widgets stretch to fill height.

public_menu.classes: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6 md:gap-8
public_menu.rules: Asymmetrical focus. Hero items span 2 cols. Visual rhythm.

instructions: Cards should be flat with subtle borders (no heavy shadows).
Tables must be dense and scanable.
Forms: Use 'Sheet' or 'Dialog' for editing items to keep context.
Navigation: Sticky bottom bar for categories (Thumb-friendly).
Item Cards: Large images, clear price, quick 'Add' button.
Hero: Parallax scrolling image with restaurant branding.
Detail View: Drawer/Sheet sliding up from bottom.

icons.style: Stroke width 1.5px for elegance, 2px for active states.

principles: Micro-interactions: Buttons scale down slightly on press (0.98).
Entrance: Staggered fade-in for list items.
Page: Subtle slide-up for new views.

universal_guidelines: TESTING: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.
THEME: Support Light/Dark mode toggle. Default to System preference.
RESPONSIVE: Mobile-first for Public Menu, Desktop-first (but responsive) for Admin.
ERROR STATES: Clear, red-tinted borders and helpful error messages.
LOADING: Use Skeleton loaders, not spinners, for content areas.
instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a dual-interface app. 1. Admin Panel (Private, Functional, Dense). 2. Public Menu (Public, Visual, Spacious). Do not mix the styles. Use the 'Sage & Earth' palette to unify them, but vary the layout density. Implement the 'Bento' grid for the Admin Dashboard. Use 'Playfair Display' ONLY for the Public Menu headings to give it a premium feel.
